# Cardscape
> The self-hostable kanban your AI can drive. Open-source project management with a first-class Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. Runs on .NET 10 with SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL or MariaDB.

Cardscape is a server application (Docker Compose or the .NET SDK). It installs nothing on the user's computer. Boards, lists, cards, calendar, planner, automation rules, integrations (Slack, GitHub, email, Google Calendar, SCIM, SAML), API tokens and audit logs.

## Quick start
    git clone https://github.com/FittyAr/Cardscape.git && cd Cardscape
    echo "CARDS_CAPE_JWT_KEY=$(openssl rand -base64 48)" > .env
    docker compose up -d
Then open http://localhost:7420.

## Paths
- Docker data: named volumes cardscape.data, cardscape.uploads, cardscape.keys, cardscape.postgres_data.
- User config/data for local (non-Docker) tools: %APPDATA%\FittyAr\Cardscape (Windows), ~/.config/FittyAr/Cardscape (Linux), ~/Library/Application Support/FittyAr/Cardscape (macOS).
- Installed apps (none today): %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\FittyAr\Cardscape.
